history.title: Zantetsu release
history.text: Legendary Zantetsu arrived with a secret awakening. Five Halloween limited styles returned.

history.title: June balance pass
history.text: Reo's copied shots received cooldown and power nerfs; many other styles and flows changed.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Reaper Sae and Halloween
history.text: Reaper Sae and Halloween update; Demon Shidou was scheduled separately.
